children.name: horizontal
children.label: Horizontal
children.help_text: A positive value puts the shadow on the right side of the box, a negative value puts the shadow on the left side of the box

children.name: vertical
children.label: Vertical
children.help_text: The vertical offset of the shadow. A positive value puts the shadow below the box, a negative value puts the shadow above the box

children.name: blur
children.label: Blur
children.help_text: The blur radius. The higher the number, the more blurred the shadow will be

children.name: spread
children.label: Spread
children.help_text: The spread radius. A positive value increases the size of the shadow, a negative value decreases the size of the shadow

children.name: inset
children.label: Inset
children.help_text: Changes the shadow to an inner shadow

children.name: color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: The color of the shadow

default.tab_content: Quickly and efficiently build the materials you need to support your inbound marketing strategy. Drag and drop building blocks including testimonials, forms, calls-to-action, and more.
Sprocket Rocket lets you transform your rapid prototype into a beautiful design by adjusting every aspect to fit brand standards.

Collaborate seamlessly across devices from wherever you may be – whether you’re in the office, on the go, or making last-minute changes before your next meeting.

From start-to-finish, the design and strategy team provide all of the guidance and expertise necessary to build a high-conversion website.
Select from a collection of modules and quickly populate and draft website and landing pages right to HubSpot.

Get started on website and landing pages right away with little to no learning curve.

Without rigid templates, you can build the exact type of website necessary to hit your website performnace goals.
You can use modular design to get the exact building blocks you need to build beautiful website and landing pages.
